titleEn: Maximum Number of Fish in a Grid
title: 网格图中鱼的最大数目
summary: 网格中零是陆地，正数是水域鱼数；可从任意水格出发在四邻水格间移动，求能捕获的最大鱼数。
insight: 每个四连通正数分量代表一次出发可覆盖的全部水域。遍历网格，对尚未访问的正数格做 BFS，累加分量鱼数并取最大值；把访问值置零即可原地标记。
pitfalls: 不能经过值为零的陆地
可任选起点所以比较所有连通分量
访问时先清零避免重复入队

solutions.title: 洪泛搜索连通分量鱼数
solutions.idea: 逐个累加四连通水域总和。
steps: 遇到正数格加入队列并置零
BFS 弹出格子累加原值，四邻正数格入队并清零
一个分量结束后更新 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int findMaxFish(int[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length,answer=0;int[] directions={-1,0,1,0,-1};for(int startRow=0;startRow<rows;startRow++)for(int startCol=0;startCol<cols;startCol++)if(grid[startRow][startCol]>0){Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();int fish=grid[startRow][startCol];grid[startRow][startCol]=0;queue.add(new int[]{startRow,startCol});while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] cell=queue.poll();for(int d=0;d<4;d++){int row=cell[0]+directions[d],col=cell[1]+directions[d+1];if(row>=0&&row<rows&&col>=0&&col<cols&&grid[row][col]>0){fish+=grid[row][col];grid[row][col]=0;queue.add(new int[]{row,col});}}}answer=Math.max(answer,fish);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findMaxFish(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val rows=grid.size;val cols=grid[0].size;val directions=intArrayOf(-1,0,1,0,-1);var answer=0;for(startRow in 0 until rows)for(startCol in 0 until cols)if(grid[startRow][startCol]>0){val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();var fish=grid[startRow][startCol];grid[startRow][startCol]=0;queue.add(intArrayOf(startRow,startCol));while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val cell=queue.removeFirst();for(d in 0 until 4){val row=cell[0]+directions[d];val col=cell[1]+directions[d+1];if(row in 0 until rows&&col in 0 until cols&&grid[row][col]>0){fish+=grid[row][col];grid[row][col]=0;queue.add(intArrayOf(row,col))}}};answer=maxOf(answer,fish)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int findMaxFish(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),cols=grid[0].size(),answer=0,directions[5]={-1,0,1,0,-1};for(int startRow=0;startRow<rows;++startRow)for(int startCol=0;startCol<cols;++startCol)if(grid[startRow][startCol]>0){queue<pair<int,int>> pending;int fish=exchange(grid[startRow][startCol],0);pending.push({startRow,startCol});while(!pending.empty()){auto [currentRow,currentCol]=pending.front();pending.pop();for(int d=0;d<4;++d){int row=currentRow+directions[d],col=currentCol+directions[d+1];if(row>=0&&row<rows&&col>=0&&col<cols&&grid[row][col]>0){fish+=exchange(grid[row][col],0);pending.push({row,col});}}}answer=max(answer,fish);}return answer;} };
